uz: 'Cold reheat' va 'hot reheat' — bug'ni turbinaning yuqori bosim qismidan chiqib, HRSG'da qayta qizdirilib, o'rta bosim qismiga qaytishi. Bu FIKni oshiradi.
en: 'Cold reheat' and 'hot reheat' describe steam leaving the HP turbine, being reheated in the HRSG, and returning to the IP turbine. This raises efficiency.

uz: 'Reheat' sikli bug'ni ikki marta qizdirib, undan ko'proq ish oladi va oxirgi bosqichda bug'ni quruqroq saqlaydi.
en: The 'reheat' cycle heats steam twice, extracting more work and keeping the steam drier in the final stages.

uz: 'Auxiliary boiler' (yordamchi qozon) — stansiya ishga tushishdan oldin kerakli bug'ni beradi (masalan gland seal uchun). Asosiy tizim ishga tushgach, u o'chiriladi.
en: An 'auxiliary boiler' provides the steam needed before the plant starts (e.g. for gland seals). Once the main system runs, it's shut off.

uz: Stansiya 'muyoq' (chicken-and-egg) muammosini yordamchi qozon hal qiladi: bug' hosil qilish uchun bug' kerak bo'lganda, u boshlang'ich bug'ni beradi.
en: An auxiliary boiler solves a 'chicken-and-egg' problem: when steam is needed to make steam, it provides the initial steam.

uz: 'Pressure transmitter' (bosim datchigi) suyuqlik yoki gaz bosimini o'lchab, uni elektr signalga aylantiradi. Stansiyada yuzlab shunday datchiklar bor.
en: A pressure transmitter measures the pressure of liquid or gas and converts it to an electrical signal. A plant has hundreds of them.

uz: Sanoat datchiklari ko'pincha '4-20 mA' signal beradi — 4 mA eng past, 20 mA eng yuqori qiymat. Bu shovqinga chidamli standart.
en: Industrial sensors often output a '4-20 mA' signal — 4 mA is the lowest, 20 mA the highest value. It's a noise-resistant standard.

uz: 'Flow meter' (oqim o'lchagich) quvurdan o'tayotgan suyuqlik yoki gaz miqdorini o'lchaydi. Turli tiplari bor: differensial bosim, ultratovush, magnit.
en: A flow meter measures the amount of liquid or gas passing through a pipe. Types include differential pressure, ultrasonic and magnetic.

uz: 'Level transmitter' (sath datchigi) bak yoki barabandagi suyuqlik sathini o'lchaydi. Bug' barabanida sath nazorati juda muhim — suv kam yoki ko'p bo'lsa xavfli.
en: A level transmitter measures liquid level in a tank or drum. Level control in a steam drum is critical — too little or too much water is dangerous.

uz: Bug' barabanida suv sathi juda pasaysa, qizigan quvurlar suvsiz qolib kuyishi mumkin; juda ko'tarilsa, suv turbinaga o'tib ketishi mumkin.
en: If the water level in a steam drum drops too low, hot tubes can overheat dry; if it rises too high, water can carry over into the turbine.

uz: 'PID controller' — datchik qiymatini kerakli qiymatga (setpoint) yaqinlashtirib boshqaradigan mantiq. U proporsional, integral va differensial qismlardan iborat.
en: A PID controller adjusts a process toward a desired value (setpoint) using proportional, integral and derivative terms.

uz: PID boshqaruv turbina tezligi, harorat, bosim va sathni tekis ushlaydi — u kichik og'ishni sezib, darhol tuzatadi.
en: PID control keeps turbine speed, temperature, pressure and level steady — sensing small deviations and correcting them instantly.

uz: 'Actuator' — boshqaruv signalini fizik harakatga aylantiradigan qurilma. U klapanni ochadi/yopadi yoki pichoqni buradi. Elektr, pnevmatik yoki gidravlik bo'ladi.
en: An 'actuator' converts a control signal into physical motion. It opens/closes a valve or turns a vane. It can be electric, pneumatic or hydraulic.

uz: Katta klapanlarni harakatga keltirishga ko'p kuch kerak — shuning uchun ko'pincha gidravlik (moy bosimi) yoki pnevmatik (havo bosimi) aktuatorlar ishlatiladi.
en: Moving large valves needs great force — so hydraulic (oil pressure) or pneumatic (air pressure) actuators are often used.

uz: 'Fail-safe' — nosozlik yuz berganda tizim xavfsiz holatga o'tishi. Masalan, signal yo'qolsa, yoqilg'i klapani o'z-o'zidan yopiladi.
en: 'Fail-safe' means the system moves to a safe state if a failure occurs. For example, if the signal is lost, the fuel valve closes by itself.

uz: 'Solenoid valve' — elektr signal bilan ochilib-yopiladigan kichik klapan. U ko'pincha katta klapanlarni boshqaruvchi 'pilot' vazifasini bajaradi.
en: A 'solenoid valve' is a small valve opened/closed by an electric signal. It often acts as a 'pilot' controlling larger valves.

uz: Solenoid klapan ichida elektromagnit bor — tok berilsa u pistonchani tortadi va klapan holatini o'zgartiradi.
en: A solenoid valve contains an electromagnet — when energized it pulls a plunger and changes the valve's state.

uz: 'Check valve' (qaytmas klapan) suyuqlikni faqat bir yo'nalishda o'tkazadi. U orqaga oqishni to'sib, nasos va jihozlarni himoya qiladi.
en: A 'check valve' lets fluid pass in only one direction. It blocks backflow, protecting pumps and equipment.

uz: 'Relief valve' (himoya klapani) bosim xavfli darajaga chiqsa, o'z-o'zidan ochilib ortiqcha bosimni chiqaradi. U portlashning oldini oladi.
en: A 'relief valve' opens by itself when pressure rises to a dangerous level, releasing excess pressure. It prevents explosions.

uz: Relief klapani ma'lum bosimda ochiladigan qilib sozlanadi — u tizimning 'xavfsizlik qopqog'i' vazifasini bajaradi.
en: A relief valve is set to open at a specific pressure — acting as the system's 'safety cap'.

uz: 'Heat exchanger' (issiqlik almashtirgich) ikki suyuqlik orasida issiqlikni ular aralashmasdan uzatadi. Stansiyada ular hamma joyda: coolerlar, kondensator, HRSG.
en: A heat exchanger transfers heat between two fluids without mixing them. They're everywhere in a plant: coolers, condenser, HRSG.

uz: 'Shell-and-tube' issiqlik almashtirgichda bir suyuqlik quvurlar ichidan, ikkinchisi ular atrofidan oqadi — issiqlik quvur devori orqali o'tadi.
en: In a 'shell-and-tube' heat exchanger, one fluid flows inside tubes and another around them — heat passes through the tube walls.

uz: 'Fouling' — issiqlik almashtirgich yuzasida cho'kma to'planib, issiqlik o'tishini yomonlashtirishi. Davriy tozalash uni bartaraf etadi.
en: 'Fouling' is deposit buildup on heat exchanger surfaces, worsening heat transfer. Periodic cleaning removes it.

uz: 'Centrifugal pump' (markazdan qochma nasos) aylanuvchi g'ildirak (impeller) bilan suyuqlikni tashqariga uloqtirib, bosim hosil qiladi. Stansiyadagi eng keng tarqalgan nasos.
en: A centrifugal pump uses a spinning impeller to fling liquid outward, creating pressure. It's the most common pump in a plant.

uz: 'Cavitation' — nasos ichida bosim juda pasayib, suyuqlikda bug' pufakchalari hosil bo'lishi. Ular portlab, nasosni yeydi va shovqin chiqaradi.
en: 'Cavitation' is when pressure inside a pump drops so low that vapor bubbles form in the liquid. They implode, eroding the pump and making noise.

uz: 'NPSH' (Net Positive Suction Head) — nasos so'rish tomonida cavitationdan qochish uchun kerak bo'lgan minimal bosim. Uni ta'minlash muhim.
en: NPSH (Net Positive Suction Head) is the minimum pressure needed at a pump's suction to avoid cavitation. Ensuring it is important.

uz: Nasosga issiq suyuqlik (masalan qaynash haroratiga yaqin suv) berilsa cavitation xavfi ortadi — shuning uchun so'rish bosimi yetarli bo'lishi kerak.
en: Feeding a pump hot liquid (e.g. water near boiling) raises cavitation risk — so suction pressure must be sufficient.

uz: 'Fan' va 'blower' havoni harakatga keltiradi. Ventilyatorlar sovutish, tortish (draft) va ventilyatsiya uchun stansiyada ko'p ishlatiladi.
en: Fans and blowers move air. They're widely used in a plant for cooling, draft and ventilation.

uz: 'Damper' va 'louver' havo yoki gaz oqimini rostlaydigan burilma plastinkalar. Ular ventilyatsiya va chiqindi tizimida oqimni boshqaradi.
en: 'Dampers' and 'louvers' are pivoting plates that regulate air or gas flow. They control flow in ventilation and exhaust systems.

uz: 'Draft' — mo'ridagi havo/gaz oqimini haydovchi bosim farqi. 'Forced draft' ventilyator havoni itaradi, 'induced draft' esa tortadi.
en: 'Draft' is the pressure difference driving air/gas flow in a stack. A 'forced draft' fan pushes air, an 'induced draft' fan pulls it.

uz: 'Silencer' (shovqin pasaytirgich) turbina kirish va chiqishidagi kuchli shovqinni kamaytiradi. U tovush to'lqinlarini yutuvchi materiallardan iborat.
en: A 'silencer' reduces the loud noise at a turbine's inlet and exhaust. It's made of sound-absorbing materials.

uz: Stansiya shovqini nazorat qilinadi — turbina, transformator va ventilyatorlar shovqin chiqaradi. Shovqin himoyasi ishchilar salomatligi uchun muhim.
en: Plant noise is controlled — turbines, transformers and fans produce noise. Noise protection matters for worker health.

uz: Yuqori shovqinli hududlarda quloq himoyasi majburiy — uzoq muddat kuchli shovqin eshitishga zarar yetkazadi.
en: Hearing protection is mandatory in high-noise areas — prolonged loud noise damages hearing.

uz: 'Grounding grid' — stansiya ostidagi yer ostiga ko'milgan metall to'r. U nosozlik tokini yerga tarqatib, xavfsiz kuchlanishni ta'minlaydi.
en: A 'grounding grid' is a metal mesh buried under the plant. It disperses fault current into the earth, ensuring safe voltages.

uz: Yaxshi yerlashtirish nosozlik paytida odam turgan joyda xavfli 'qadam kuchlanishi' (step voltage) paydo bo'lishining oldini oladi.
en: Good grounding prevents dangerous 'step voltage' at a person's feet during a fault.

uz: 'SCADA' — masofadan nazorat va ma'lumot yig'ish tizimi. U operatorlarga stansiyani (yoki ko'p stansiyani) markazdan kuzatish imkonini beradi.
en: SCADA is a supervisory control and data acquisition system. It lets operators monitor a plant (or many plants) centrally from a distance.

uz: SCADA va DCS birga ishlaydi: DCS jarayonni real vaqtda boshqaradi, SCADA esa umumiy kuzatuv va ma'lumot yig'ish uchun.
en: SCADA and DCS work together: DCS controls the process in real time, while SCADA provides overall supervision and data collection.

uz: 'Historian' — stansiya ma'lumotlarini yillar davomida saqlaydigan ma'lumotlar bazasi. U nosozlik tahlili va samaradorlikni yaxshilashda ishlatiladi.
en: A 'historian' is a database storing plant data over years. It's used for fault analysis and improving performance.

uz: 'Cyber security' zamonaviy stansiyalarda muhim — DCS va SCADA tizimlari tashqi hujumlardan himoyalanadi, chunki ular jismoniy jihozni boshqaradi.
en: Cyber security matters in modern plants — DCS and SCADA systems are protected from external attacks, since they control physical equipment.

uz: Muhim boshqaruv tizimlari ko'pincha internetdan ajratiladi ('air gap') — bu masofadan buzg'unchilikning oldini oladi.
en: Critical control systems are often isolated from the internet (an 'air gap') — preventing remote intrusion.

uz: 'Commissioning' — yangi stansiyani ishga tushirishdan oldin har bir tizimni sinab, sozlab, tekshirish jarayoni. U oylab davom etadi.
en: 'Commissioning' is testing, tuning and verifying every system before a new plant enters service. It can take months.

uz: 'Performance test' — stansiya kafolatlangan quvvat va FIKga erishganini rasmiy o'lchash. U qabul qilish (acceptance) uchun muhim.
en: A 'performance test' formally measures whether a plant achieves its guaranteed power and efficiency. It's key for acceptance.

uz: Gaz turbinasi rotori bitta uzun val — unda kompressor va turbina qismlari birga o'rnatilgan. Ular bir tezlikda, bir yo'nalishda aylanadi.
en: A gas turbine rotor is one long shaft carrying both the compressor and turbine sections. They rotate together at one speed, in one direction.

uz: Gaz turbinasida foydali quvvat = turbina ishlab chiqargan quvvat minus kompressorga sarflangan quvvat. Kompressor 'ochko'ziroq' bo'lsa, foydali quvvat kamayadi.
en: In a gas turbine, useful power = turbine power minus compressor power. The 'greedier' the compressor, the less useful power remains.

uz: Kompressorda havo bosqichma-bosqich siqiladi. Har bosqichda bosim biroz oshadi, harorat ham ko'tariladi — chiqishda havo juda issiq va zich bo'ladi.
en: Air is compressed stage by stage. Each stage raises pressure a little and temperature too — the air leaves very hot and dense.

uz: Kompressor chiqishidagi havo harorati faqat siqilishdan 400°C dan oshishi mumkin — hali yoqilg'i yonmasidan oldin.
en: Compressor discharge air can exceed 400°C from compression alone — even before any fuel is burned.

uz: Yonish kamerasiga kompressordan issiq, siqilgan havo keladi va unga yoqilg'i qo'shib yoqiladi. Bu gazni yanada qizdirib, energiyasini oshiradi.
en: The combustor receives hot, compressed air from the compressor, adds fuel and burns it. This further heats the gas, raising its energy.

uz: Yonish kamerasida faqat yoqilg'ining bir qismini yoqishga havo ishlatiladi; qolgan havo alangani sovutish va gazni aralashtirishga ketadi.
en: Only part of the air in a combustor is used to burn fuel; the rest cools the flame and mixes the gas.

uz: Turbina qismida issiq gaz kengayadi va pichoqlarni aylantiradi. Bu aylanish valni, val esa ham kompressorni, ham generatorni harakatga keltiradi.
en: In the turbine section hot gas expands and spins the blades. This rotation turns the shaft, which drives both the compressor and the generator.

uz: Turbina birinchi bosqich pichoqlari eng issiq gazga duchor bo'ladi — shuning uchun ular eng ko'p sovutiladigan va eng qimmat qismlardir.
en: The turbine's first-stage blades face the hottest gas — so they are the most heavily cooled and most expensive parts.

uz: Gaz turbinasi vali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri generatorga ulanadi (yoki reduktor orqali). Turbina aylanishi generatorda elektr hosil qiladi.
en: The gas turbine shaft connects directly to the generator (or via a gearbox). The turbine's rotation produces electricity in the generator.

uz: 50 Hz to'r uchun 2 qutbli generator 3000 ayl/min da aylanishi kerak — gaz turbinasi aynan shu tezlikda ishlaydi, shu bois to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulanadi.
en: For a 50 Hz grid a 2-pole generator must spin at 3000 rpm — a gas turbine runs at exactly this speed, so it connects directly.

uz: Gaz turbinasidan chiqqan ~600°C gaz HRSG'ga kiradi. Bu issiqlik suvni qizdirib, bug'ga aylantiradi — combined cycle'ning ikkinchi bosqichi shu.
en: The ~600°C gas leaving the gas turbine enters the HRSG. This heat warms water into steam — the second stage of combined cycle.

uz: HRSG'siz gaz turbinasi issiqligining katta qismi mo'ridan behuda uchib ketardi. HRSG shu issiqlikni 'ushlab', qo'shimcha elektr ishlab chiqaradi.
en: Without an HRSG, much of the gas turbine's heat would escape uselessly up the stack. The HRSG captures it to make extra electricity.

uz: HRSG'da hosil bo'lgan bug' bug' turbinasiga boradi va uni aylantiradi. Bug' turbinasi ham o'z generatorini (yoki bir vali) harakatga keltiradi.
en: Steam made in the HRSG goes to the steam turbine and spins it. The steam turbine also drives its own generator (or a shared shaft).

uz: Ba'zi stansiyalarda gaz va bug' turbinasi bitta valda — 'single shaft'. Ular bitta generatorni birga harakatga keltiradi.
en: In some plants the gas and steam turbines share one shaft — 'single shaft'. They drive a single generator together.

uz: Gaz turbinasi podshipniklari juda yuqori tezlikda va yukda ishlaydi. Ular doimiy moy oqimi bilan sovutilib-moylanadi, aks holda bir necha soniyada ishdan chiqadi.
en: Gas turbine bearings run at very high speed and load. They are continuously cooled and lubricated by oil flow — without it they'd fail in seconds.

uz: Moy tizimida bak, nasoslar, sovutgichlar va filtrlar bor. Moy podshipniklardan qizib qaytadi, sovutiladi, filtrlanadi va yana haydaladi.
en: The oil system has a tank, pumps, coolers and filters. Oil returns hot from the bearings, is cooled, filtered and pumped again.

uz: Generatordan chiqqan elektr avval 'generator circuit breaker' orqali o'tadi, keyin step-up transformatorda kuchlanishi oshiriladi va to'rga uzatiladi.
en: Power from the generator first passes through a generator circuit breaker, then its voltage is raised in the step-up transformer and sent to the grid.

uz: 'Generator circuit breaker' generatorni to'rdan tez ajratishga imkon beradi — bu nosozlik yoki texnik xizmat paytida muhim.
en: A generator circuit breaker allows quickly isolating the generator from the grid — important during a fault or maintenance.

uz: Ishga tushirishda ketma-ketlik: rotorni aylantirish (SFC) → purge → yoqish (ignition) → tezlashtirish → sinxronizatsiya → yuklama berish. Har qadam tekshiriladi.
en: The startup sequence: spin the rotor (SFC) → purge → ignition → accelerate → synchronize → apply load. Each step is verified.

uz: Sinxronizatsiya lahzasi juda muhim — generator chastotasi, kuchlanishi va fazasi to'rga aniq mos kelganda circuit breaker ulanadi.
en: The moment of synchronization is critical — the breaker closes only when the generator's frequency, voltage and phase exactly match the grid.

uz: Gaz turbinasiga kirayotgan havo katta hajmda — u avval filtr, keyin silencer (shovqin pasaytirgich) va duct (kanal) orqali kompressorga boradi.
en: The air entering a gas turbine is large in volume — it first passes a filter, then a silencer and duct before reaching the compressor.

uz: Kirish havo tizimidagi bosim yo'qotishlari (filtr, kanal) turbina quvvatini biroz kamaytiradi — shuning uchun ular past qarshilikli qilib loyihalanadi.
en: Pressure losses in the inlet air path (filter, duct) slightly reduce turbine power — so they are designed for low resistance.

uz: Gaz turbinasi chiqindi gazi HRSG'ga borishdan oldin 'diffuser' orqali o'tadi — u oqimni sekinlashtirib, bosimni tiklaydi va energiyani tejaydi.
en: Gas turbine exhaust passes through a 'diffuser' before the HRSG — it slows the flow, recovers pressure and saves energy.

uz: Kompressordan olingan sovutuvchi havo turbina disklari va pichoqlarini sovutadi — bu havo keyin asosiy gaz oqimiga qo'shilib ketadi.
en: Cooling air taken from the compressor cools turbine discs and blades — this air then rejoins the main gas flow.

uz: GT boshqaruv tizimi yuzlab datchikdan (harorat, bosim, tezlik, vibratsiya) ma'lumot oladi va yoqilg'i, IGV, klapanlarni real vaqtda boshqaradi.
en: The GT control system reads hundreds of sensors (temperature, pressure, speed, vibration) and manages fuel, IGVs and valves in real time.

uz: Chiqindi gaz harorati (EGT/exhaust temperature) gaz turbinasi 'sog'lig'ining' asosiy ko'rsatkichi — boshqaruv uni chegaradan oshirmaydi.
en: Exhaust gas temperature (EGT) is a key indicator of gas turbine 'health' — the control system keeps it below limits.

uz: Gaz turbinasi rejali ta'mir tsikli 'operating hours' va 'starts' ga bog'liq — qaysi biri avval chegaraga yetsa, o'sha inspection vaqtini belgilaydi.
en: A gas turbine's maintenance interval depends on both operating hours and starts — whichever reaches its limit first sets the inspection time.

uz: 'Hot gas path inspection' — turbinaning eng issiq qismlarini (pichoq, transition piece) ko'zdan kechirish va almashtirish. Bu eng muhim ta'mir turlaridan.
en: A 'hot gas path inspection' examines and replaces the turbine's hottest parts (blades, transition pieces). It's among the most important overhauls.

uz: GTCC stansiyasida gaz turbinasi umumiy quvvatning ~2/3 qismini, bug' turbinasi ~1/3 qismini beradi — bir yoqilg'idan ikki manba.
en: In a GTCC plant the gas turbine provides ~2/3 of total power and the steam turbine ~1/3 — two sources from one fuel.

uz: Bug' turbinasi qo'shimcha yoqilg'i yoqmasdan quvvat beradi — u faqat gaz turbinasining 'bepul' chiqindi issiqligidan foydalanadi.
en: The steam turbine produces power without burning extra fuel — it uses only the 'free' waste heat of the gas turbine.

uz: Bug' turbinasidan chiqqan bug' kondensatorda sovib suvga aylanadi. Bu suv qaytadan HRSG'ga haydaladi — yopiq sikl, suv behuda ketmaydi.
en: Steam leaving the steam turbine condenses to water in the condenser. This water is pumped back to the HRSG — a closed loop, no water wasted.

uz: Kondensatordagi vakuum bug'ning ko'proq kengayishiga imkon beradi — bu bug' turbinasidan olinadigan quvvatni sezilarli oshiradi.
en: The vacuum in the condenser lets steam expand more — this significantly increases the power extracted from the steam turbine.

uz: Elektr energiya deyarli saqlanmaydi — u ishlab chiqarilgan zahoti iste'mol qilinadi. Shuning uchun stansiyalar talabga qarab real vaqtda quvvatni moslaydi.
en: Electricity is barely storable — it is consumed the instant it's generated. So plants adjust output to demand in real time.

uz: IGV (Inlet Guide Vanes) kompressor kirishida joylashib, havo miqdorini rostlaydi. Ishga tushirishda yopiq, to'liq quvvatda ochiq holatga keladi.
en: IGVs sit at the compressor inlet and regulate airflow. They are closed at startup and open toward full-power operation.

uz: IGV yopiq bo'lganda kam havo kiradi — bu ishga tushirishda kompressor 'surge'ining oldini oladi va yumshoq start beradi.
en: With IGVs closed, less air enters — this prevents compressor surge at startup and gives a smooth start.

uz: Part-load (qisman quvvat)da IGV havo oqimini kamaytiradi — bu chiqindi gaz haroratini yuqori ushlab, HRSG samaradorligini saqlaydi.
en: At part-load the IGVs reduce airflow — this keeps exhaust temperature high, maintaining HRSG efficiency.

uz: IGV yordamida combined cycle qisman quvvatda ham yuqori FIK saqlaydi — bug' turbinasi issiq gazdan yetarli bug' oladi.
en: Thanks to IGVs, combined cycle keeps high efficiency even at part-load — the steam turbine still gets enough hot gas for steam.

uz: Gaz turbinasi 'firing temperature' — turbinaga kirayotgan gaz harorati. U qancha yuqori bo'lsa, FIK va quvvat shuncha yuqori, lekin materiallar shuncha sinovda.
en: A gas turbine's 'firing temperature' is the gas temperature entering the turbine. Higher means more efficiency and power, but greater material stress.

uz: J-class turbinalar firing temperaturani ~1600°C ga ko'targani uchun rekord FIK beradi — bu ilg'or sovutish va materiallar tufayli mumkin bo'ldi.
en: J-class turbines reach a ~1600°C firing temperature, giving record efficiency — made possible by advanced cooling and materials.

uz: DLN (Dry Low NOx) combustor yoqilg'ini havo bilan oldindan aralashtirib yoqadi. Bu 'premix' yonish alangani sovuqroq va tekisroq qiladi, NOx kamayadi.
en: A DLN (Dry Low NOx) combustor pre-mixes fuel with air before burning. This 'premix' combustion makes the flame cooler and more even, lowering NOx.

uz: NOx (azot oksidi) juda yuqori haroratli alangada ko'proq hosil bo'ladi — shuning uchun DLN alangani nazorat ostida sovuqroq ushlaydi.
en: NOx (nitrogen oxides) forms more in very hot flames — so DLN keeps the flame controlled and cooler.

uz: 'Combustion dynamics' — yonish kamerasidagi bosim tebranishlari. Kuchli tebranish qismlarni yorib yuborishi mumkin, shuning uchun u kuzatiladi va nazorat qilinadi.
en: 'Combustion dynamics' are pressure oscillations in the combustor. Strong oscillations can crack parts, so they are monitored and controlled.

uz: Premix yonish samarali, lekin 'combustion dynamics'ga moyil — shuning uchun DLN turbinalarda bosim tebranishi doimiy nazoratda bo'ladi.
en: Premix combustion is efficient but prone to combustion dynamics — so pressure oscillation is continuously monitored in DLN turbines.

uz: Generator ichida rotor aylanib magnit maydon yaratadi, statordagi mis o'ramlarda esa elektr toki 'induksiya' qilinadi. Bu Faradey qonuni asosida ishlaydi.
en: Inside a generator the rotor spins to create a magnetic field, and current is 'induced' in the stator's copper windings. This works by Faraday's law.

uz: Generator quvvatini oshirish uchun rotorga ko'proq magnitlash toki (excitation) beriladi — bu kuchliroq magnit maydon va yuqori kuchlanish demakdir.
en: To raise generator output, more magnetizing (excitation) current is fed to the rotor — meaning a stronger field and higher voltage.

uz: Katta generator juda ko'p issiqlik chiqaradi. Sovutish uchun ichida vodorod yoki havo yopiq aylanadi va cooler'da soviydi.
en: A large generator produces a lot of heat. For cooling, hydrogen or air circulates inside in a closed loop and is cooled in a cooler.

uz: Vodorod bilan sovutish samaraliroq va shovqinni kamaytiradi, lekin vodorod portlovchi bo'lgani uchun zichlash va xavfsizlik tizimlari juda muhim.
en: Hydrogen cooling is more effective and reduces windage noise, but since hydrogen is explosive, sealing and safety systems are critical.

uz: Generatorni himoya qiluvchi relelar ko'p turdagi nosozlikni kuzatadi: qisqa tutashuv, ortiqcha tok, teskari quvvat, yer bilan tutashuv va h.k.
en: Relays protecting a generator watch for many fault types: short circuit, overcurrent, reverse power, earth fault and more.

uz: 'Reverse power' himoyasi generator motor bo'lib qolishini sezadi — agar turbina quvvat bermay qolsa, generator to'rdan tok tortib aylanaveradi, bu xavfli.
en: Reverse power protection detects the generator becoming a motor — if the turbine stops driving it, the generator draws power from the grid, which is dangerous.

uz: 'Differential protection' generator yoki transformatorga kirayotgan va chiqayotgan tokni solishtiradi. Farq bo'lsa — ichkarida nosozlik bor, darhol uziladi.
en: Differential protection compares current entering and leaving a generator or transformer. A difference means an internal fault — it trips instantly.

uz: Podshipnikda val to'g'ridan-to'g'ri metallga tegmaydi — u yupqa bosimli moy pardasida 'suzadi'. Bu 'hydrodynamic' moylash deb ataladi.
en: In a bearing the shaft never touches metal directly — it 'floats' on a thin pressurized oil film. This is called hydrodynamic lubrication.

uz: Ishga tushirishda val sekin aylanadi va moy pardasi hali zaif — shuning uchun ba'zi turbinalarda 'jacking oil' yuqori bosimli moy valni ko'taradi.
en: At startup the shaft turns slowly and the oil film is weak — so some turbines use high-pressure 'jacking oil' to lift the shaft.

uz: HRSG ko'p bosimli bo'ladi: HP (yuqori), IP (o'rta), LP (past). Har bosim darajasi chiqindi gaz issiqligining turli qismidan foydalanadi.
en: An HRSG is multi-pressure: HP (high), IP (intermediate), LP (low). Each pressure level uses a different portion of the exhaust heat.

uz: Ko'p bosimli HRSG chiqindi gaz issiqligidan maksimal foydalanadi — issiqroq gaz HP bug' hosil qiladi, sovuqroq gaz LP bug' va suvni isitadi.
en: A multi-pressure HRSG extracts the most from exhaust heat — hotter gas makes HP steam, cooler gas makes LP steam and heats water.

uz: Bug' turbinasi HP, IP va LP bosqichlardan iborat. Bug' avval HP'da, keyin qayta qizdirilib IP'da, oxirida LP'da kengayadi.
en: A steam turbine has HP, IP and LP sections. Steam expands first in HP, then (after reheating) in IP, and finally in LP.

uz: Bug' LP bosqichida eng ko'p kengayadi — shuning uchun LP pichoqlari eng uzun (metrga yaqin) va turbinaning eng katta qismi.
en: Steam expands most in the LP section — so LP blades are the longest (nearly a meter) and the biggest part of the turbine.

uz: Combined cycle ishga tushishi bosqichma-bosqich: avval gaz turbinasi, keyin HRSG bug' hosil qiladi, oxirida bug' turbinasi qo'shiladi. To'liq quvvatga chiqish vaqt oladi.
en: A combined cycle starts in stages: first the gas turbine, then the HRSG raises steam, finally the steam turbine joins. Reaching full power takes time.

uz: Bug' turbinasi ishga tushishi uchun HRSG yetarli bug' hosil qilishi kerak — shuning uchun u gaz turbinasidan keyin, biroz kechroq qo'shiladi.
en: The steam turbine needs the HRSG to raise enough steam first — so it joins a bit later, after the gas turbine.

uz: Yoqilg'i gaz tizimi gazni filtrlaydi, bosimini rostlaydi va isitadi. Toza, to'g'ri bosimli, iliq gaz barqaror yonishni ta'minlaydi.
en: The fuel gas system filters the gas, regulates its pressure and heats it. Clean, correctly pressured, warm gas ensures stable combustion.

uz: Yoqilg'i gaz isitilganda uning energiyasining bir qismi combined cycle issiqligidan olinadi — bu FIKni yanada oshiradi ('fuel gas heating').
en: When fuel gas is heated, part of that heat comes from the combined cycle itself — this further raises efficiency ('fuel gas heating').

uz: 'Boiler feed pump' HRSG'ga suvni yuqori bosim ostida haydaydi. U stansiyadagi eng quvvatli va muhim nasoslardan biri.
en: The boiler feed pump forces water into the HRSG at high pressure. It's one of the most powerful and critical pumps in the plant.

uz: Feed pump ishlamay qolsa, HRSG suvsiz qolib quvurlari kuyishi mumkin — shuning uchun ko'pincha zaxira feed pump bo'ladi.
en: If the feed pump fails, the HRSG could run dry and its tubes overheat — so a backup feed pump is usually provided.

uz: Stansiya DCS (Distributed Control System) orqali boshqariladi. Operatorlar nazorat xonasidagi ekranlar orqali butun stansiyani kuzatadi va boshqaradi.
en: The plant is run through a DCS (Distributed Control System). Operators monitor and control the whole plant via screens in the control room.

uz: DCS minglab nuqtani (harorat, bosim, klapan holati) real vaqtda ko'rsatadi va ko'p jarayonni avtomatik boshqaradi — operator faqat nazorat qiladi.
en: A DCS displays thousands of points (temperature, pressure, valve position) in real time and automates many processes — the operator mainly supervises.

uz: Vibratsiya monitoringi turbina 'salomatligining' asosiy ko'rsatkichi. Podshipniklardagi datchiklar vibratsiyani doimiy o'lchaydi — o'sishi nosozlikdan darak beradi.
en: Vibration monitoring is a key indicator of turbine 'health'. Sensors on the bearings measure vibration continuously — a rise signals trouble.

uz: Vibratsiya keskin oshsa turbina avtomatik 'trip' bo'ladi — bu rotorning tegib ketishi yoki parchalanishidan katta zararning oldini oladi.
en: If vibration rises sharply the turbine automatically trips — preventing major damage from rotor rubbing or breaking apart.

uz: Combined cycle FIKi ~60% dan yuqori — bu ma'noda u dunyodagi eng samarali issiqlik elektr stansiyasi turi. Sababi: bir yoqilg'idan ikki marta ish olinadi.
en: Combined cycle efficiency exceeds ~60% — making it the most efficient type of thermal power plant. The reason: work is extracted twice from one fuel.

q: Combined cycle stansiyasida gaz turbinasining issiq chiqindi gazi qayerga boradi?
explain: Chiqindi gaz HRSG'da bug' hosil qiladi va bug' turbinasini aylantiradi.

q: Nega to'xtagan issiq turbina rotori 'turning gear' bilan aylantirib turiladi?
explain: Issiq rotor bir joyda tursa og'irligidan egiladi va vibratsiya beradi.

q: Nega turbina pichoqlarining ichi bo'sh (kanalli) qilinadi?
options: Ichidan sovuq havo o'tkazib sovutish uchun
explain: Ichidan sovuq havo o'tkazib, pichoqni erib ketishdan saqlaydi.

q: Turbina moy bosimi to'satdan yo'qolsa nima bo'ladi?
explain: Podshipniklar sovutish va moylashsiz shikastlanadi, shuning uchun darhol trip.

q: 'Overspeed trip' nima uchun kerak?
options: Turbina xavfli tezlashsa to'xtatib, parchalanishdan saqlash
explain: Haddan tashqari tezlikda rotor parchalanishi mumkin — trip buni oldini oladi.

q: Generatorni to'rga (grid) ulashdan oldin nima qilinadi?
explain: Chastota, kuchlanish va faza to'rga aniq mos kelmasa kuchli zarba bo'ladi.

q: Nega 'cold start' 'hot start'dan uzoqroq davom etadi?
explain: Sovuq qismlarni tez qizdirish termik kuchlanish va shikast keltiradi.

q: DLN yonish kamerasining asosiy maqsadi nima?
explain: Yoqilg'ini havo bilan oldindan aralashtirib, sovuqroq alanga va kam NOx beradi.

q: Generatorning qaysi qismi aylanadi?
explain: Rotor aylanib magnit maydon yaratadi; stator qo'zg'almas, unda tok hosil bo'ladi.

q: 'Thrust bearing' (o'q podshipnigi) nima vazifani bajaradi?
explain: Journal bearing yon tomondan, thrust bearing esa o'q bo'ylab ushlab turadi.

q: Turbina kabinasi nega doimiy ventilyatsiya qilinadi?
options: Issiqlik va sizgan gazni tarqatib, portlashni oldini olish
explain: Gaz to'planib qolmasligi kerak, aks holda portlash xavfi tug'iladi.

q: CO₂ o't o'chirish tizimi olovni qanday o'chiradi?
explain: Bo'limni CO₂ bilan to'ldiradi — olov kislorodsiz o'chadi. Odamlar oldin chiqishi kerak.

q: HRSG'da 'superheater' nima qiladi?
explain: Quruq, yuqori energiyali bug' turbina pichoqlarini namlik shikastidan saqlaydi.

q: Sovutish minorasidan chiqadigan oq 'tutun' aslida nima?
explain: Bu tutun emas — bug'langan suvning kondensatlangan bug'i.

q: IGV (Inlet Guide Vanes) pichoqlari nima uchun kerak?
explain: Havo miqdorini rostlab, turbina quvvatini va barqarorligini boshqaradi.

q: Kompressor 'surge'i nima?
explain: Teskari oqim kuchli tebranish va pichoqlarga shikast keltiradi; IGV/VV buni oldini oladi.

q: Nega yirik generatorlar vodorod (H₂) bilan sovutiladi?
options: Vodorod havodan ~7 barobar yaxshi issiqlik o'tkazadi
explain: Yaxshi issiqlik o'tkazishi va shovqinni kamaytirishi tufayli; lekin portlovchi, ehtiyot shart.

q: SFC (Static Frequency Converter) gaz turbinasini qanday ishga tushiradi?
options: Generatorni motor qilib ishlatib, rotorni aylantiradi
explain: Generator vaqtincha motor bo'lib, turbina rotorini yonish boshlanguncha aylantiradi.

q: Nega generator kuchlanishi to'rga uzatishdan oldin oshiriladi?
options: Yuqori kuchlanishda uzatish yo'qotishlari kam bo'ladi
explain: Yuqori kuchlanishda tok kichrayadi, shu bois uzatishdagi issiqlik yo'qotishlari kamayadi.

q: Neytral yerlashtirish (neutral grounding) nima uchun kerak?
options: Nosozlik tokini xavfsiz yo'naltirib himoya qilish
explain: Nosozlikda tokni yerga xavfsiz yo'naltirib, jihoz va odamlarni himoya qiladi.

q: Circuit breaker (avtomatik uzgich) va oddiy kalit farqi nima?
options: Breaker nosozlikda avtomatik va tez uzadi
explain: Breaker nosozlikda o'zi trip qiladi; oddiy kalit faqat qo'lda ulash/uzish uchun.

q: Nega tok va kuchlanish CT/VT orqali o'lchanadi (to'g'ridan emas)?
options: Katta qiymatni xavfsiz kichiraytirib, asboblarni himoya qilish
explain: CT/VT katta tok/kuchlanishni xavfsiz kichik qiymatga aylantiradi.

q: Alanga datchigi (flame detector) alanga o'chganini sezsa nima bo'ladi?
explain: Aks holda yonmagan gaz to'planib portlash xavfi tug'iladi.

q: 'Once-through' HRSG barabanli HRSG'dan qanday farq qiladi?
options: Barabani yo'q — suv to'g'ridan bug'ga aylanadi
explain: Barabansiz — tez ishga tushadi, lekin suv sifatiga qattiqroq talab qo'yadi.

q: Kondensatorda vakuum yo'qolsa nima bo'ladi?
options: Bug' kam kengayadi, quvvat va FIK tushadi
explain: Past bosim bug'ning ko'proq kengayishiga imkon beradi; vakuumsiz quvvat tushadi.

q: Qozon 'blowdown'i nima uchun qilinadi?
options: To'plangan tuzlarni chiqarib, quyqa/korroziyani oldini olish
explain: Bug'lanishdan to'plangan tuzlarni chiqarib tashlaydi.

q: Nega bug' quruq (yuqori sifatli) bo'lishi kerak?
explain: Suv tomchilari yuqori tezlikda pichoqqa urilib ularni asta yeydi.

q: Bug'ni 'reheat' qilish (qayta qizdirish) nima beradi?
options: Ko'proq ish, yuqori FIK, quruqroq bug'
explain: Ikki marta qizdirib ko'proq ish oladi va oxirgi bosqichda bug'ni quruqroq saqlaydi.

q: Nega hech qanday elektr stansiyasi 100% samarali emas?
options: Termodinamika: issiqning bir qismi doim atrofga ketadi
explain: Termodinamika qonuniga ko'ra issiqlikning bir qismi doim sovuq manbaga tarqaladi.

q: Black start qobiliyati nima uchun muhim?
options: To'r o'chganda stansiya o'zini toksiz ishga tushiradi
explain: Total blackoutdan keyin tashqi toksiz ishga tushib, to'rni tiklashga yordam beradi.

q: Nega kompressor chiqishida havo issiq bo'ladi?
explain: Bosim oshgani sari harorat ko'tariladi — yoqilg'i yonmasidan oldin ham 400°C dan oshadi.

q: Turbinaning qaysi pichoqlari eng qattiq issiqlikka duchor bo'ladi?
explain: Birinchi bosqich eng issiq gaz oqimini birinchi qabul qiladi — eng ko'p sovutiladi.

q: Nega gaz turbinasi generatorga ko'pincha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulanadi?
options: Uning tezligi (3000 ayl/min) 50 Hz uchun aynan mos
explain: 3000 ayl/min 2 qutbli 50 Hz generator uchun aynan to'g'ri keladi.

q: GT boshqaruv tizimi yoqilg'ini nima asosida rostlaydi?
options: Yuzlab datchik ma'lumoti asosida, real vaqtda
explain: Harorat, tezlik, bosim, vibratsiya datchiklaridan ma'lumot olib real vaqtda boshqaradi.

q: Vibratsiya keskin oshsa turbina nima qiladi?
explain: Katta shikast (tegib ketish, parchalanish)ning oldini olish uchun avtomatik to'xtaydi.

q: Borescope inspection nima afzallik beradi?
explain: Ingichka kamera orqali ichki pichoqlarni ko'radi — vaqt va xarajat tejaydi.

q: LOTO (Lockout-Tagout) nima uchun kerak?
options: Ta'mirda jihoz tasodifan yoqilishining oldini olish
explain: Energiya manbai qulflanadi; faqat ishchi o'zi ochadi — bexos yoqilishdan himoya.

q: Nega tor makonga (confined space) kirishdan oldin havo tekshiriladi?
options: Kislorod yetarli va zaharli gaz yo'qligiga ishonch uchun
explain: Kislorod kam yoki zaharli/yonuvchi gaz bo'lishi mumkin — tekshirilmasa xavfli.

q: GTCC'da bug' turbinasi taxminan qancha quvvat beradi?
explain: Gaz turbinasi ~2/3, bug' turbinasi ~1/3 — qo'shimcha yoqilg'isiz.

q: Gaz turbinasida foydali quvvat qanday hisoblanadi?
explain: Kompressor turbina quvvatining deyarli yarmini iste'mol qiladi; qolgani foydali.

q: IGV ishga tushirishda nega yopiq turadi?
explain: Kam havo bilan yumshoq start beradi va kompressor surge'ining oldini oladi.

q: Yonish kamerasidagi havoning hammasi yoqilg'i yonishiga ketadimi?
explain: Bir qismi yonishga, ko'p qismi alangani sovutish va gazni aralashtirishga ketadi.

q: 'Single shaft' combined cycle nima degani?
options: Gaz va bug' turbinasi bir valda, bitta generator
explain: Ikkala turbina bir valda joylashib, bitta generatorni birga harakatga keltiradi.

q: Moy podshipnikda qaysi ikki vazifani bajaradi?
explain: Ishqalanishni kamaytiradi (moylash) va issiqlikni olib chiqadi (sovutish).

q: Generator elektri to'rga borishdan oldin qayerdan o'tadi?
explain: Avval generator circuit breaker, keyin step-up transformatorda kuchlanish oshiriladi.

q: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushirishda 'purge' qaysi qadamda bo'ladi?
explain: Yonuvchi gazni tozalab, yoqishda portlash xavfini yo'qotadi.

q: Kirish havo yo'lidagi filtr va kanal turbina quvvatiga qanday ta'sir qiladi?
options: Bosim yo'qotishi tufayli quvvatni biroz kamaytiradi
explain: Shuning uchun ular past qarshilikli qilib loyihalanadi.

q: Turbinani sovutgan havo qayerga boradi?
options: Asosiy gaz oqimiga qo'shilib HRSG tomon
explain: Sovutuvchi havo asosiy gaz oqimiga qo'shilib, chiqindi bilan HRSG'ga ketadi.

q: Nega combined cycle oddiy gaz turbinasidan ancha samarali?
options: Chiqindi issiqlikni bug' turbinasida ham ishlatadi
explain: Bir yoqilg'idan ikki marta ish — gaz turbinasi + bug' turbinasi.

q: Kondensatdan keyin suv qayerga boradi?
explain: Sikl yopiq — suv qayta-qayta ishlatiladi, behuda ketmaydi.

q: Nega stansiyalar quvvatni doimiy moslab turadi?
explain: Elektr ishlab chiqarilgan zahoti iste'mol qilinadi, ikkalasi teng bo'lishi kerak.

q: Kompressor bosqichida stator (qo'zg'almas) pichoqlari nima qiladi?
explain: Rotor pichoqlar tezlashtiradi, stator pichoqlar tezlikni bosimga aylantiradi.

q: 'Firing temperature' oshsa nima yutuq va nima xavf?
options: Yutuq: FIK/quvvat; Xavf: materiallarga issiqlik yuki
explain: Yuqori harorat samaradorlikni oshiradi, lekin materiallarni ko'proq sinaydi.

q: NOx (azot oksidi) qachon ko'proq hosil bo'ladi?
explain: Shuning uchun DLN alangani nazorat ostida sovuqroq ushlab NOx'ni kamaytiradi.

q: Generatorda tok qaysi qismda hosil bo'ladi?
explain: Aylanuvchi rotor magnit maydoni statordagi o'ramlarda tok induksiya qiladi.

q: 'Reverse power' himoyasi nimani sezadi?
options: Generator motor bo'lib, to'rdan tok tortishini
explain: Turbina quvvat bermay qolsa generator to'rdan tok tortadi — bu xavfli holat.

q: 'Differential protection' qanday ishlaydi?
explain: Farq bo'lsa ichkarida nosozlik bor deb darhol uzadi.

q: 'Jacking oil' nima uchun kerak?
options: Sekin aylanishda valni ko'tarib, metall tegishdan saqlash
explain: Start/stopda moy pardasi zaif — jacking oil valni ko'taradi.

q: Nega HRSG ko'p bosim darajasida ishlaydi (HP/IP/LP)?
explain: Issiqroq gaz HP bug', sovuqroq gaz LP bug' hosil qiladi.

q: Nega bug' turbinasi LP pichoqlari eng uzun bo'ladi?
options: Past bosimda bug' hajmi juda katta
explain: Past bosimli katta hajmdagi bug'ni qabul qilish uchun uzun pichoqlar kerak.

q: Combined cycle'da nega bug' turbinasi gaz turbinasidan keyin ishga tushadi?
options: Avval HRSG yetarli bug' hosil qilishi kerak
explain: HRSG bug' hosil qilishi uchun gaz turbinasidan issiq gaz kerak.

q: Yoqilg'i gaz tizimi gazni qanday tayyorlaydi?
explain: Toza, to'g'ri bosimli, iliq gaz barqaror yonishni ta'minlaydi.

q: 'Boiler feed pump' nima qiladi?
explain: Yuqori bosim ostida suvni HRSG'ga haydab, bug' hosil bo'lishini ta'minlaydi.

q: DCS operatorga nima imkon beradi?
explain: Minglab nuqtani real vaqtda ko'rsatib, ko'p jarayonni avtomatik boshqaradi.

q: Gaz turbinasi ta'mir vaqtini nima belgilaydi?
options: Ishlagan soatlar yoki startlar — qaysi biri avval
explain: Qaysi biri avval chegaraga yetsa, o'sha inspection vaqtini belgilaydi.

q: Nega part-load (qisman quvvat)da IGV havo oqimini kamaytiradi?
options: Chiqindi gaz haroratini yuqori ushlab HRSG samaradorligini saqlash
explain: Yuqori chiqindi harorati bug' turbinasiga yetarli bug' beradi, FIK saqlanadi.

q: DLN combustor NOx'ni qanday kamaytiradi?
explain: Premix yonish sovuqroq va tekisroq alanga beradi, NOx kamayadi.

q: Reaktiv quvvat (var) nima uchun kerak?
explain: Foydali ish bajarmasa ham to'r kuchlanishini barqaror ushlash uchun zarur.

q: VFD (o'zgaruvchan chastota drayveri) qanday energiya tejaydi?
explain: Nasos har doim to'liq tezlikda aylanmaydi — talabga moslab energiya tejaydi.

q: Nasosdagi 'cavitation' nima va nega zararli?
options: Bosim pasayib bug' pufakchalari portlab nasosni yeydi
explain: Past bosimda bug' pufakchalari hosil bo'lib, portlaydi va nasosni yemiradi.

q: 'Check valve' (qaytmas klapan) nima vazifani bajaradi?
explain: Orqaga oqishni to'sib, nasos va jihozlarni himoya qiladi.

q: 'Relief valve' (himoya klapani) qachon ochiladi?
explain: Ortiqcha bosimni chiqarib portlashning oldini oladi — tizimning 'xavfsizlik qopqog'i'.

q: 'Fail-safe' klapan signal yo'qolganda nima qiladi?
explain: Masalan yoqilg'i klapani signal yo'qolsa o'zi yopiladi — xavfsiz holat.

q: '2-out-of-3' datchik mantig'i nega ishlatiladi?
options: Bitta datchik yanglishsa ham to'g'ri qaror
explain: Uch datchikdan ikkitasi rozi bo'lsa harakat — ko'pchilik ovoz g'olib.

q: 'Alarm' va 'trip' o'rtasidagi farq nima?
explain: Alarm — e'tibor ber; trip — jihozni zudlik bilan xavfsiz to'xtatadi.

q: Nega turbina 'kritik tezlik'dan tez o'tkaziladi?
explain: Kritik tezlikda rotor rezonansga tushadi; uzoq turish shikast keltiradi.

q: '2x1' combined cycle nima degani?
options: Ikki gaz turbinasi bitta bug' turbinasiga
explain: Ikki gaz turbinasining chiqindi issig'i bitta bug' turbinasini ta'minlaydi.

q: Past 'heat rate' nimani bildiradi?
explain: Heat rate past bo'lsa FIK yuqori — kam issiqlik bilan ko'p elektr.

uz: Releli himoya — elektr tizimidagi nosozlikni (qisqa tutashuv, ortiqcha yuk) avtomatik sezib, shikastlangan qismni tez uzib tashlaydigan tizim. U elektr tarmog'ining 'qorovuli'.
en: Relay protection is a system that automatically senses faults (short circuit, overload) in the power system and quickly disconnects the damaged part. It's the 'guard' of the electrical network.

uz: Releli himoyaning asosiy vazifasi — nosozlikni imkon qadar tez o'chirib, jihoz shikastini va energetika tizimining barqarorligiga tahdidni kamaytirish.
en: The main task of relay protection is to clear a fault as fast as possible, minimizing equipment damage and threats to power system stability.

uz: Releli himoyaning to'rt asosiy talabi bor: selektivlik (tanlovchanlik), tezkorlik, sezgirlik va ishonchlilik. Yaxshi himoya shu to'rttasini birga ta'minlaydi.
en: Relay protection has four key requirements: selectivity, speed, sensitivity and reliability. Good protection provides all four together.

uz: Selektivlik (tanlovchanlik) — himoya faqat shikastlangan qismni uzishi, sog'lom qismlarni esa ishlab turishga qoldirishi. Bu iste'molchilar keraksiz o'chib qolmasligini ta'minlaydi.
en: Selectivity means protection disconnects only the faulted part, leaving healthy parts in service. This keeps consumers from being needlessly cut off.

q: Releli himoyada 'selektivlik' (tanlovchanlik) nima degani?
options: Faqat shikastlangan qismni uzish, sog'lomini qoldirish
explain: Selektivlik faqat nosoz qismni uzib, iste'molchilarni keraksiz o'chishdan saqlaydi.

uz: Tezkorlik — himoya nosozlikni qanchalik tez o'chirishi. Yuqori kuchlanishli tarmoqlarda (330-500 kV) qisqa tutashuv 0,06-0,08 sekundda o'chirilishi kerak.
en: Speed is how fast protection clears a fault. In high-voltage networks (330-500 kV) a short circuit must be cleared in 0.06-0.08 seconds.

uz: Qisqa tutashuvni tez o'chirish energetika tizimining barqarorligini saqlaydi — kechiksa, generatorlar sinxronizmdan chiqib, avariya kengayishi mumkin.
en: Fast fault clearing preserves power system stability — if delayed, generators can lose synchronism and the disturbance can spread.

uz: Sezgirlik — himoyaning eng kichik nosozlikni ham sezish qobiliyati. U tizimning barcha rejimlarida, hatto minimal rejimda ham yetarli bo'lishi kerak.
en: Sensitivity is the ability to detect even the smallest fault. It must be sufficient in all system modes, even minimum mode.

uz: Ishonchlilik — himoya kerak bo'lganda albatta ishlashi, kerak bo'lmaganda esa yolg'on ishlamasligi. Sxema soddaligi va sifatli elementlar ishonchlilikni oshiradi.
en: Reliability means protection operates when needed and does not misoperate when not needed. Simple schemes and quality components improve reliability.

q: Releli himoyaning to'rt asosiy talabi qaysilar?
explain: Yaxshi himoya shu to'rt talabni birga ta'minlaydi.

uz: 'Asosiy himoya' shikastni birinchi bo'lib o'chirishga mo'ljallangan. Agar u ishlamay qolsa, 'zaxira himoya' (rezerv) uni almashtirib, nosozlikni o'chiradi.
en: 'Main protection' is meant to clear a fault first. If it fails, 'backup protection' takes over and clears the fault instead.

uz: Zaxira himoya biroz kechikish bilan ishlaydi — u avval asosiy himoyaga imkon beradi, faqat u ishlamasagina o'zi harakatga kiradi.
en: Backup protection operates with a slight delay — it first gives the main protection a chance, acting only if the main one fails.

q: 'Zaxira himoya' (backup) qachon ishlaydi?
explain: Zaxira himoya biroz kechikish bilan, asosiy himoya ishlamasa harakatga kiradi.

uz: Rele — kirish kattaligi (tok, kuchlanish) belgilangan qiymatdan oshsa ishga tushadigan qurilma. U kontaktlarini yopib, uzgichga 'uz' buyrug'ini beradi.
en: A relay is a device that operates when its input quantity (current, voltage) exceeds a set value. It closes contacts and sends a 'trip' command to the breaker.

uz: Ilk relelar elektromexanik edi (aylanuvchi disk, prujina). Zamonaviylari raqamli (mikroprotsessorli) — ular tez, aniq va ko'p funksiyani bir qurilmada bajaradi.
en: Early relays were electromechanical (rotating disc, spring). Modern ones are digital (microprocessor-based) — fast, accurate, and combining many functions in one device.

uz: 'Tokli himoya' (current protection) tarmoqdagi tokni kuzatadi. Qisqa tutashuvda tok keskin oshadi — himoya buni sezib, zanjirni uzadi.
en: Current protection monitors the current in the network. In a short circuit the current rises sharply — the protection senses this and trips the circuit.

uz: Qisqa tutashuv toki normal ish tokidan o'nlab, ba'zan yuzlab barobar katta bo'lishi mumkin — shuning uchun uni sezish nisbatan oson.
en: A short-circuit current can be tens, sometimes hundreds of times larger than normal load current — so it is relatively easy to detect.

q: Qisqa tutashuvda tok qanday o'zgaradi?
explain: Tok keskin oshgani uchun tokli himoya uni oson sezadi va zanjirni uzadi.

uz: 'Maksimal tokli himoya' (MTZ) tok belgilangan chegaradan oshsa ishga tushadi. Bu eng oddiy va keng tarqalgan himoya turi.
en: 'Overcurrent protection' (MTZ) operates when current exceeds a set threshold. It is the simplest and most widespread type of protection.

uz: Maksimal tokli himoya selektivligini ta'minlash uchun vaqt kechikishi ishlatiladi — manbadan uzoqroq himoyalar tezroq, yaqinrog'i sekinroq ishlaydi.
en: To make overcurrent protection selective, time delays are used — protections farther from the source act faster, those nearer act slower.

q: Maksimal tokli himoya (MTZ) qachon ishga tushadi?
explain: MTZ — eng oddiy va keng tarqalgan himoya, tok chegaradan oshsa ishlaydi.

uz: 'Tok otsechkasi' (tez ishlovchi tokli himoya) juda katta toklarda darhol, kechikishsiz ishlaydi. U faqat manbaga yaqin, eng xavfli qisqa tutashuvlarga javob beradi.
en: An 'instantaneous overcurrent' (current cut-off) operates immediately, without delay, at very high currents. It responds only to the most dangerous faults near the source.

uz: Tok otsechkasi vaqt kechikishisiz ishlagani uchun eng tez himoyalardan biri — lekin u faqat liniyaning bir qismini qamraydi, butunini emas.
en: Because it acts without time delay, current cut-off is among the fastest protections — but it covers only part of a line, not all of it.

uz: 'Vaqt kechikishi' (vidergka vremeni) himoyalar orasida muvofiqlik yaratadi. Har bosqich o'zidan oldingisidan bir 'pog'ona' (masalan 0,3-0,5 s) sekinroq ishlaydi.
en: A 'time delay' coordinates protections. Each stage acts one 'step' slower (e.g. 0.3-0.5 s) than the previous one.

q: Nega maksimal tokli himoyada vaqt kechikishi ishlatiladi?
explain: Vaqt kechikishi himoyalar orasida muvofiqlik yaratib, faqat kerakli qism uzilishini ta'minlaydi.

uz: 'Tok transformatori' (TT) tarmoqdagi katta tokni kichik, o'lchash mumkin bo'lgan tokka (masalan 5 A yoki 1 A) aylantiradi. Rele shu kichik tok bilan ishlaydi.
en: A current transformer (CT) scales the large network current down to a small, measurable one (e.g. 5 A or 1 A). The relay works with this small current.

uz: Tok transformatori relelarni yuqori kuchlanishdan ajratadi ham — rele xavfsiz, past kuchlanishli tomonda ishlaydi.
en: A current transformer also isolates relays from high voltage — the relay works safely on the low-voltage side.

q: Tok transformatori (TT) nima qiladi?
options: Katta tokni kichik o'lchanadigan tokka aylantiradi
explain: Katta tokni 5A yoki 1A ga aylantirib, rele bilan xavfsiz o'lchash imkonini beradi.

uz: 'Kuchlanish transformatori' (KT) yuqori kuchlanishni past (masalan 100 V) ga aylantiradi — kuchlanishga bog'liq himoyalar va o'lchash asboblari uchun.
en: A voltage transformer (VT) reduces high voltage to a low level (e.g. 100 V) — for voltage-dependent protections and measuring instruments.

uz: 'Differensial himoya' himoyalanadigan qismga kirayotgan va chiqayotgan tokni solishtiradi. Normal holatda ular teng; farq paydo bo'lsa — ichkarida nosozlik bor.
en: Differential protection compares current entering and leaving the protected element. Normally they're equal; a difference means an internal fault.

uz: Differensial himoya juda selektiv — u faqat o'z zonasidagi nosozlikka javob beradi, tashqi qisqa tutashuvga esa umuman ta'sir qilmaydi.
en: Differential protection is highly selective — it responds only to faults within its zone and not at all to external short circuits.

q: Differensial himoya qanday ishlaydi?
explain: Kirish va chiqish toki farqi ichki nosozlikni ko'rsatadi; differensial himoya juda selektiv.

uz: Transformatorning differensial himoyasi uning ikki tomonidagi tokni solishtiradi. Ichki nosozlik (o'ram tutashuvi) bo'lsa, tok muvozanati buziladi va himoya ishlaydi.
en: A transformer's differential protection compares currents on its two sides. An internal fault (winding short) upsets the balance and the protection operates.

uz: Transformator ulanganda kuchli 'magnitlash toki' (inrush) o'tadi — u nosozlikka o'xshaydi. Differensial himoya buni ajratib, yolg'on ishlamasligi kerak.
en: When a transformer is energized, a large 'inrush' magnetizing current flows — it resembles a fault. Differential protection must distinguish it and not misoperate.

q: Transformator ulanganda o'tadigan 'inrush' toki himoyaga qanday muammo tug'diradi?
explain: Differensial himoya inrush tokini haqiqiy nosozlikdan ajrata olishi kerak.

uz: 'Gaz himoyasi' (Buxgolts relesi) moyli transformatorda ichki nosozlikda hosil bo'ladigan gazni sezadi. Yengil nosozlikda signal, kuchli nosozlikda uzish beradi.
en: Gas protection (Buchholz relay) senses gas formed by an internal fault in an oil-filled transformer. It signals for minor faults and trips for severe ones.

uz: Buxgolts relesi transformator ichidagi nosozlikni (o'ram kuyishi, yoy) gaz pufakchalari orqali sezadi — bu elektr o'lchovlar ko'ra olmagan nosozlikni ham topadi.
en: A Buchholz relay detects internal transformer faults (winding burn, arcing) via gas bubbles — catching faults even electrical measurements might miss.

q: Buxgolts (gaz) relesi nimani sezadi?
options: Transformator ichidagi nosozlikdan hosil bo'lgan gazni
explain: Ichki nosozlikda gaz hosil bo'ladi; yengil holda signal, kuchli holda uzish beradi.

uz: 'Masofaviy himoya' (distansion) nosozlikkacha bo'lgan masofani (impedans) o'lchaydi. Nosozlik yaqin bo'lsa tez, uzoq bo'lsa sekinroq uzadi — bu selektivlikni beradi.
en: Distance protection measures the distance (impedance) to a fault. A near fault trips fast, a far one slower — providing selectivity.

uz: Masofaviy himoya uzun yuqori kuchlanishli liniyalarda keng ishlatiladi — u tok va kuchlanish nisbatidan nosozlik masofasini hisoblaydi.
en: Distance protection is widely used on long high-voltage lines — it computes fault distance from the ratio of voltage to current.

q: Masofaviy (distansion) himoya nimani o'lchaydi?
explain: Nosozlik yaqin bo'lsa tez, uzoq bo'lsa sekin uzadi — tok/kuchlanish nisbatidan masofa topiladi.

uz: 'Yerga tutashuv himoyasi' bir faza yerga tegib qolganda ishlaydi. Bunday nosozlik ko'p uchraydi va uni tez topish muhim.
en: Earth-fault protection operates when one phase touches earth. Such faults are common, and detecting them quickly is important.

uz: Yerga tutashuv toki tarmoq neytralining yerlashtirilish usuliga bog'liq — u kichik yoki katta bo'lishi mumkin, himoya shunga moslanadi.
en: Earth-fault current depends on how the network neutral is grounded — it can be small or large, and protection is adapted accordingly.

uz: 'AVR' (Avtomatik Vklyuchenie Rezerva / zaxirani avtomatik ulash) asosiy ta'minot yo'qolsa, iste'molchini zaxira manbaga avtomatik ulaydi. Bu uzilishni minimallashtiradi.
en: Automatic transfer (AVR/ATS) switches a consumer to a backup supply automatically when the main supply is lost. This minimizes interruption.

uz: 'APV' (Avtomatik Povtornoe Vklyuchenie / avtomatik qayta ulash) liniya uzilgach, uni avtomatik qayta ulashga urinadi. Ko'p qisqa tutashuvlar o'tkinchi — qayta ulaganda yo'qoladi.
en: Auto-reclosing (APV) automatically tries to re-energize a line after it trips. Many short circuits are transient — they disappear on reclosing.

q: 'APV' (avtomatik qayta ulash) nima uchun foydali?
options: Ko'p qisqa tutashuvlar o'tkinchi — qayta ulaganda yo'qoladi
explain: O'tkinchi nosozlik (masalan chaqmoq) qayta ulaganda ketadi, ta'minot tiklanadi.

uz: Havo liniyalaridagi qisqa tutashuvlarning ko'pi o'tkinchi (chaqmoq, shamol) — shuning uchun APV ta'minotni tez tiklab, uzilishni qisqartiradi.
en: Most faults on overhead lines are transient (lightning, wind) — so auto-reclosing quickly restores supply and shortens outages.

uz: Motorlar ham himoyalanadi: ortiqcha yukdan (issiqlik), qisqa tutashuvdan, faza yo'qolishidan va kuchlanish pasayishidan. Har biri motor uchun xavfli.
en: Motors are also protected: from overload (thermal), short circuit, phase loss and undervoltage. Each is dangerous for a motor.

q: Elektr motor qaysi nosozlikdan himoyalanadi?
options: Ortiqcha yuk, qisqa tutashuv, faza yo'qolishi
explain: Ortiqcha yuk (issiqlik), qisqa tutashuv, faza yo'qolishi va kuchlanish pasayishi motorga xavfli.

uz: Liniya (elektr uzatish liniyasi) himoyasi eng muhim vazifalardan biri, chunki liniyalar uzun va ochiq havoda — chaqmoq, shamol, muz ularga tez-tez ta'sir qiladi.
en: Line (transmission line) protection is one of the most important tasks, because lines are long and out in the open — lightning, wind and ice frequently affect them.

uz: Uzatish liniyalari energetika tizimining eng ko'p uchraydigan nosozlik joyi — shuning uchun ular ishonchli va tez himoya bilan ta'minlanadi.
en: Transmission lines are the most common fault location in a power system — so they are equipped with reliable, fast protection.

uz: 'Tokli kesim' (otsechka) zonasi liniya uzunligining faqat bir qismini (odatda 80-85%) qamraydi. Qolgan qismi zaxira himoya orqali himoyalanadi.
en: A 'current cut-off' zone covers only part of a line's length (usually 80-85%). The remainder is covered by backup protection.

uz: Tokli kesim liniyaning boshini tez himoya qiladi, lekin oxirini qamramaydi — chunki uzoq nosozlikda tok kamayadi va kesim uni ajrata olmaydi.
en: Current cut-off protects the start of a line quickly but not its far end — because for a distant fault the current is lower and the cut-off can't distinguish it.

q: Nega tokli kesim (otsechka) liniyaning butun uzunligini qamramaydi?
options: Uzoq nosozlikda tok kamayadi, kesim ajrata olmaydi
explain: Faqat boshini (80-85%) tez himoya qiladi; qolgani zaxira himoyada.

uz: 'Bosqichli himoya' (stupenchataya) bir necha zonadan iborat: birinchi zona tez, keyingilari kechikish bilan. Bu selektivlik va zaxira himoyani birga beradi.
en: 'Stepped protection' has several zones: the first is fast, the later ones delayed. This provides both selectivity and backup together.

q: Bosqichli (stupenchataya) himoyaning birinchi zonasi qanday ishlaydi?
explain: Birinchi zona tez ishlaydi; keyingi zonalar kechikish bilan zaxira vazifasini o'taydi.

uz: Yo'nalishli himoya (directional) nafaqat tokni, balki uning yo'nalishini ham hisobga oladi. U faqat 'himoyalanadigan tomonga' oqadigan nosozlik tokiga javob beradi.
en: Directional protection considers not only the current but also its direction. It responds only to fault current flowing 'toward the protected side'.

uz: Yo'nalishli himoya ikki tomondan quvvat keladigan tarmoqlarda kerak — u nosozlik qaysi tomonda ekanini ajratib, faqat kerakli uzgichni uzadi.
en: Directional protection is needed in networks fed from both sides — it identifies which side the fault is on and trips only the right breaker.

q: Yo'nalishli himoya tokdan tashqari yana nimani hisobga oladi?
explain: Faqat himoyalanadigan tomonga oqadigan nosozlik tokiga javob beradi — ikki tomonlama tarmoqda muhim.

uz: Generator himoyasi murakkab — u statordagi qisqa tutashuv, yerga tutashuv, ortiqcha yuk, teskari quvvat va rotor nosozliklaridan himoya qiladi.
en: Generator protection is complex — it guards against stator short circuits, earth faults, overload, reverse power and rotor faults.

uz: Generator differensial himoyasi stator o'ramidagi ichki qisqa tutashuvni bir zumda sezadi — bu eng xavfli va tez himoya talab qiladigan nosozlik.
en: A generator's differential protection instantly senses an internal stator winding short — the most dangerous fault, needing the fastest protection.

q: Generator differensial himoyasi qaysi nosozlikni sezadi?
explain: Ichki qisqa tutashuv eng xavfli — differensial himoya uni bir zumda sezadi.

uz: 'Teskari quvvat himoyasi' generator motor bo'lib qolganini sezadi — turbina quvvat bermay qolsa, generator to'rdan tok tortib aylanaveradi, bu turbinaga zararli.
en: Reverse power protection detects a generator becoming a motor — if the turbine stops driving it, the generator draws power from the grid, harming the turbine.

uz: Shina (busbar) himoyasi — podstansiyaning eng muhim nuqtasini himoya qiladi. Shinada nosozlik butun podstansiyani o'chirishi mumkin, shuning uchun himoya juda tez bo'lishi kerak.
en: Busbar protection guards the most critical point of a substation. A busbar fault can shut down the whole substation, so its protection must be very fast.

uz: Shina differensial himoyasi shinaga ulangan barcha liniyalar tokini yig'adi — normal holatda yig'indi nol, nosozlikda esa noldan farq qiladi.
en: Busbar differential protection sums the currents of all lines connected to the busbar — normally the sum is zero, but in a fault it differs from zero.

q: Nega shina (busbar) himoyasi juda tez bo'lishi kerak?
options: Shina nosozligi butun podstansiyani o'chirishi mumkin
explain: Shina eng muhim nuqta — undagi nosozlik butun podstansiyaga ta'sir qiladi.

uz: 'Operativ zanjir' (operativnie tsepi) — relelar, uzgichlar va signal qurilmalarini bog'laydigan boshqaruv zanjiri. U odatda o'zgarmas tok (batareya) bilan ishlaydi.
en: The 'control circuit' (operative circuit) links relays, breakers and signaling devices. It usually runs on DC (battery) power.

uz: Operativ zanjir batareyada ishlagani uchun asosiy tok yo'qolganda ham himoya ishlaydi — bu ishonchlilik uchun hayotiy muhim.
en: Because the control circuit runs on battery, protection works even when the main power is lost — vital for reliability.

q: Nega releli himoyaning operativ zanjiri batareya (DC) da ishlaydi?
options: Asosiy tok yo'qolganda ham ishlashi uchun
explain: Batareya tufayli asosiy ta'minot yo'qolganda ham himoya ishlaydi — ishonchlilik uchun.

uz: Chastota himoyasi (ChAPV/AChR) tizim chastotasi xavfli pasaysa ishga tushadi. Chastota pasayishi ishlab chiqarish talabdan kam ekanini bildiradi.
en: Frequency protection (load shedding) operates when system frequency drops dangerously. A frequency drop means generation is below demand.

uz: AChR (avtomatik chastotali yuklamani tushirish) chastota pasayganda bir qism iste'molchini avtomatik uzadi — bu qolgan tizimni to'liq qulashdan saqlaydi.
en: Automatic frequency load shedding disconnects some consumers when frequency drops — saving the rest of the system from total collapse.

q: Chastota xavfli pasayganda AChR nima qiladi?
options: Bir qism iste'molchini uzib, tizimni saqlaydi
explain: Chastota pasayishi ishlab chiqarish yetishmasligini bildiradi; yuk tushirish tizimni qulashdan saqlaydi.

uz: Telemexanika — podstansiyalarni masofadan boshqarish va kuzatish tizimi. Dispetcher markazdan turib uzgichlarni ulash/uzish va holatni ko'rish imkoniga ega.
en: Telemechanics is a system for remote control and monitoring of substations. A dispatcher can switch breakers and view status from a central point.

uz: Dispetcherlik boshqaruvi butun energetika tizimini bir markazdan muvofiqlashtiradi — u quvvat oqimini, chastotani va avariyalarni real vaqtda kuzatadi.
en: Dispatcher control coordinates the entire power system from one center — monitoring power flow, frequency and faults in real time.

q: Telemexanika nima imkon beradi?
explain: Dispetcher markazdan uzgichlarni boshqaradi va holatni real vaqtda ko'radi.

uz: Zamonaviy raqamli (mikroprotsessorli) relelar bir qurilmada ko'p funksiyani bajaradi: himoya, o'lchash, qayd qilish (registratsiya) va aloqa.
en: Modern digital (microprocessor) relays combine many functions in one device: protection, measurement, event recording and communication.

uz: Raqamli rele nosozlik paytidagi tok va kuchlanishni yozib oladi ('fault record') — bu keyin nosozlik sababini tahlil qilishda juda qimmat.
en: A digital relay records the current and voltage during a fault ('fault record') — invaluable later for analyzing the fault's cause.

q: Raqamli (mikroprotsessorli) relening afzalligi nima?
options: Bir qurilmada ko'p funksiya + nosozlikni yozib olish
explain: Himoya, o'lchash, qayd qilish va aloqani birlashtiradi; fault record tahlil uchun qimmat.

uz: Rele 'o'rnatma' (ustavka/setting) — himoya ishga tushadigan aniq qiymat. To'g'ri o'rnatma selektivlik va sezgirlikni ta'minlaydi; noto'g'ri o'rnatma yolg'on ishlashga olib keladi.
en: A relay 'setting' is the exact value at which protection operates. Correct settings ensure selectivity and sensitivity; wrong ones cause misoperation.

uz: Rele o'rnatmalari hisob-kitob bilan tanlanadi — qisqa tutashuv toklari, yuk toklari va boshqa himoyalar bilan muvofiqlik hisobga olinadi.
en: Relay settings are chosen by calculation — accounting for short-circuit currents, load currents and coordination with other protections.

q: Rele 'o'rnatmasi' (ustavka) nima?
explain: To'g'ri o'rnatma selektivlik va sezgirlikni beradi; noto'g'risi yolg'on ishlashga olib keladi.

uz: Himoyaning 'ishga tushish toki' — undan oshsa rele ishlaydigan tok. U eng katta ish (yuk) tokidan yuqori, lekin eng kichik qisqa tutashuv tokidan past bo'lishi kerak.
en: A protection's 'pickup current' is the current above which the relay operates. It must be above the largest load current but below the smallest fault current.

q: Himoyaning ishga tushish toki qaysi oraliqda bo'lishi kerak?
options: Eng katta yuk tokidan yuqori, eng kichik qisqa tutashuv tokidan past
explain: Aks holda yuk tokida yolg'on ishlaydi yoki qisqa tutashuvni sezmaydi.

uz: 'Vozvrat koeffitsienti' (qaytish koeffitsienti) — rele qaysi tokda o'z holatiga qaytishini ko'rsatadi. U 1 ga qancha yaqin bo'lsa, himoya shuncha sezgir va aniq.
en: The 'reset ratio' shows at what current a relay returns to its rest state. The closer it is to 1, the more sensitive and accurate the protection.

uz: Himoya 'sxemalari' relelar qanday ulanganini ko'rsatadi: to'liq yulduz, to'liqsiz yulduz, uchburchak. Har biri turli nosozliklarni turlicha qamraydi.
en: Protection 'schemes' show how relays are connected: full star, incomplete star, delta. Each covers different faults differently.

uz: To'liqsiz yulduz (ikki fazali) sxema arzonroq, lekin ba'zi nosozliklarga kamroq sezgir — to'liq yulduz esa uch fazani ham qamraydi.
en: An incomplete star (two-phase) scheme is cheaper but less sensitive to some faults — a full star covers all three phases.

uz: Himoyani davriy tekshirish (proverka) muhim — rele yillar davomida ishlamay tursa ham, kerak bo'lganda albatta ishga tushishi kerak. Sozligi muntazam sinovdan o'tkaziladi.
en: Periodic testing of protection is important — a relay may sit idle for years, yet must operate when needed. Its health is regularly tested.

uz: Zamonaviy relelar o'z-o'zini tekshiradi ('self-supervision') — ichki nosozlikni sezsa signal beradi, shuning uchun ular doim ishga tayyor.
en: Modern relays perform self-supervision — they signal if they detect an internal fault, so they are always ready to operate.

q: Nega releli himoyani davriy tekshirish muhim?
options: Rele yillar ishlamay tursa ham, kerakda ishlashi shart
explain: Himoya kam ishlaydi, lekin kerak bo'lganda albatta ishga tushishi kerak — sozligi sinaladi.

uz: 'Blokirovka' — himoyani ma'lum sharoitda vaqtincha to'sib qo'yish. Masalan, kuchlanish yo'qolganda ba'zi himoyalar bloklanadi (yolg'on ishlamaslik uchun).
en: A 'block' temporarily inhibits protection under certain conditions. For example, some protections are blocked when voltage is lost (to avoid misoperation).

uz: Zamin (yerga) tutashuvda kompensatsiya: ba'zi tarmoqlar neytralida 'Petersen g'altagi' bo'ladi — u yerga tutashuv tokini kompensatsiya qilib, yoyni o'z-o'zidan o'chiradi.
en: For earth faults, some networks use a 'Petersen coil' in the neutral — it compensates the earth-fault current, self-extinguishing the arc.

uz: Petersen g'altagi o'tkinchi zamin tutashuvlarini o'z-o'zidan o'chiradi — shuning uchun bunday tarmoqlar bir faza yerga tegsa ham qisqa muddat ishlab tura oladi.
en: A Petersen coil self-extinguishes transient earth faults — so such networks can keep running briefly even with one phase touching earth.

q: Petersen g'altagi (neytralda) nima qiladi?
options: Yerga tutashuv tokini kompensatsiya qilib yoyni o'chiradi
explain: O'tkinchi zamin tutashuvini o'z-o'zidan o'chiradi — tarmoq qisqa muddat ishlab tura oladi.

uz: Releli himoya energetika tizimining 'immun tizimi' kabi — u kasallikni (nosozlik) sezadi, joyini aniqlaydi va tez ajratib, butun 'organizm'ni saqlab qoladi.
en: Relay protection is like the power system's 'immune system' — it senses illness (a fault), locates it and quickly isolates it, saving the whole 'body'.
